blind.B1: Yes. In-vivo swimming exercise arm: 4T1 tumour-bearing BALB/c mice, Tnm_swim (tumour + 30 min daily swim, vehicle gavage) vs Tnm; also Tnm_cur and Tnm_union (curcumin + swim) (S2.1.p1-p2, S2.3.p1). 12 tumours sequenced, 3 per group; the no-tumour CK group was not sequenced (S3.2.p1). Swim samples: titles Tnm-swim-1..3 and Tnm+union-1..3.
blind.B2: Each of Tnm_cur, Tnm_swim, Tnm_union vs the tumour group Tnm, n=3 vs 3 (S3.2.p3, Fig 2C). Paper counts: cur 107 (28 up/79 down), swim 134 (79/55), union 445 (154/291). The paper says 6 mice per group (S2.1.p2) but sequenced 3 tumours per group (S2.3.p1).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one tumour per mouse, 3 tumours chosen from each group (S2.3.p1). The title suffix (1-3) is only a replicate number; the expression check of that key is not supported (r=-0.034 vs 0.016, p=0.80). The pairing flag is a false positive.
blind.B4: The paper does not say whether the groups were fitted jointly or as pairs; it reports 'DESeq2 ... differential expression' and each group compared with Tnm (S2.3.p1, S3.2.p3). A pairwise vendor-style fit is the likely reading.
blind.B5: S2.3.p1: genes with |log2FoldChange| > 1 and P-value for significance < 0.05 (raw P; the text does not mention FDR). Strict inequalities as written. Counts: cur 107, swim 134, union 445 (S3.2.p3).

checks.evidence: S2.1.p2/S2.3.p1: swim arm in vivo; the run analyzed swim vs Tnm as primary.

grp from title prefix, 3/3/3/3, matches S2.3.p1/S3.2.p1; the control Tnm (vehicle gavage, no swim) is the paper's control and also the right one for swim (both vehicle). No sample excluded. The 6-vs-5-vs-3 mice per group difference is recorded in paper_data_discrepancies.

Ours (treatment/Tnm) up/down: swim 73/138, cur 110/54, union 286/237; paper 79/55, 28/79, 154/291. In all three contrasts the dominant direction is opposite to the paper's; a single global sign flip (Tnm over treatment) reproduces the dominant direction in all three (flipped: swim 138/73, cur 54/110, union 237/286). The study caveat 'no single sign flip reconciles all three' is therefore not supported. The paper does not state the sign convention; Fig 3C gene directions are not available in the text.
checks.fix: Settle the paper's sign convention (Fig 2C bars, Fig 3C/Fig S heat map direction of WNT5A, IL6, CAMK1G, or ask the authors). Until then label up/down as 'treatment vs Tnm, convention unconfirmed' and correct the study caveat; if the paper is Tnm-over-treatment, report with the sign reversed.

checks.evidence: One tumour per independent mouse (S2.3.p1); title suffix is a replicate index, expression check status not_supported; no blocking needed.
Paper silent (B4). Pairwise two-group fits are primary and a joint ~grp model is reported as sensitivity (swim 312, union 563), so both fits are available.
GEO has no batch, lane, sex or cage field; all female BALB/c; one swim session per day after gavage is part of the intervention. Recorded as 'no batch field'.
HTSeq read-count columns, integer fraction 1.0, no NaN; FPKM columns dropped. p-value histograms plausible (frac p>0.9 0.07-0.11).

pvalue < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1, strict, from S2.3.p1; audit padj<0.05 reported separately. No alternative rule in the packet table fits 134/445/107 (padj&|lfc|>1 gives 20/261/14; p&|lfc|>0.585 gives 472/1283/409), so nothing to note beyond the 1.2-1.6x excess.

Same contrasts and same rule compared. HANDBACK states counts are 1.2-1.6x the paper's and that the up/down balance does not match; it does not claim reproduction. Only the 'no single sign flip' wording is inaccurate (see direction).
checks.fix: Reword the caveat once the sign convention is settled.

human_items: Sign convention of the paper's up/down counts is not stated. Ours is the reverse in dominant direction for all three contrasts; the pattern is consistent with the paper using Tnm over treatment, but this cannot be settled from the paper text. Decide whether to report with a confirmed or flagged sign (Fig 3C / author query).
summary: 该案例的分组、对照、阈值、矩阵类型和模型都与论文一致，pairing 标记是误报（每只小鼠一个肿瘤，标题后缀只是重复编号）。唯一未决问题是方向：我们的上调/下调数在三个对比中主导方向都与论文相反，整体翻转符号即可全部对上，而论文未说明符号约定，现有 caveat 中“没有单一翻转能一致”的说法不成立。需要人工确认符号约定后再报告方向相关结论。
